- Silver - Watch for the RS line to hold its positive flip against the SPY to confirm the **RS cross** trigger, whereas a quick reversal below the benchmark will invalidate it.
- Agricultural Inputs - Watch for continued price strength and RS making further highs to confirm the **RS new high** trigger, while a failure to hold the 20-session high level will invalidate it.
- Consumer Electronics - Watch for follow-through price action confirming the **RS new high** trigger, while a drop below the prior 20-session range will invalidate it.
- Grocery Stores - Watch for an increase in momentum above 0.50 and positive acceleration to confirm this **emerging** group, while a reversal in the 5-day rank improvement will invalidate it.
